scope: Post-hoc operational classification of frozen provisional labels and saved outputs; no new model calls or independent annotation.

cases.predicate: the interchangeable lens is visibly separated from the DSLR body
cases.qualification_notes: Distinct lens detachment, return and cap removal. Preserve historical detachment after current state changes.

cases.predicate: the large central printer LCD is visibly illuminated
cases.qualification_notes: Separate central LCD illumination from earlier side-button lights. Display later darkens, which does not erase the illumination event.

cases.predicate: the round tabletop is visibly seated on the upright white support frame
cases.qualification_notes: Separate carrying/alignment from seated placement and later unsupported standing. Do not infer that every fastener is secure.

cases.predicate: the main cabinet access door is open with interior components exposed
cases.qualification_notes: Closer inspection separates earlier handle operation and camera motion from actual door opening around 18.3–18.5 s. Later close/reopen is a separate occurrence candidate.

cases.predicate: a hand is inside the clear bin of metal fasteners
cases.qualification_notes: An earlier washer-bin reach is visible around 29.5 s; later screw-bin reach is around 38.5 s. Broad metal-fasteners wording may admit the earlier occurrence, conflicting with legacy early-alert scoring.

cases.predicate: the rectangular battery is visibly clear of the DSLR battery compartment
cases.qualification_notes: Separate opening the compartment, partial ejection, full removal, and later memory-card manipulation.

cases.predicate: the action camera is visibly clear of the white molded packaging insert
cases.qualification_notes: Opening the case precedes camera extraction and must not trigger the task. Later accessory/battery work is a different event.

cases.predicate: the clear vessel is tilted with its mouth over the open reservoir
cases.qualification_notes: The visual target is vessel tilt over the opening. Do not infer water flow, amount transferred, or reservoir detachment from this pose alone.

cases.predicate: the underside face of the round perforated panel is visibly exposed
cases.qualification_notes: The ringed face shown by the legacy positive is already visible earlier. The clip establishes lifting/rotation, but underside identity and a newly revealed underside require adjudication.

cases.predicate: the upper mesh basket is tilted away from an upright cart frame
cases.qualification_notes: Legacy target segment primarily shows reorientation of the whole cart. Tilting away from an upright frame is not supported when the frame tilts too.

cases.predicate: the black drive belt is free of the machine pulley route
cases.qualification_notes: Closer review shows a loose belt clear of the pulley route around 41.5 s. The legacy 47 s pre-event checkpoint is already after removal, so valid earlier alerts could be scored false.

cases.predicate: the main cabinet access door is open with interior components exposed
cases.qualification_notes: Separate handle operation from door opening. Preserve occurrence identity across later close/reopen.

cases.predicate: the interchangeable lens is visibly separated from the DSLR body
cases.qualification_notes: Separation is visible around 7 s, earlier than the legacy 8 s positive label; later return must not erase history.

cases.predicate: the action camera is visibly clear of the white molded packaging insert
cases.qualification_notes: Distinguish opening the packaging from the camera clearing its recess.

cases.predicate: the black side panel is clear of the desktop chassis and the interior is exposed
cases.qualification_notes: Separate moving the whole tower, releasing/sliding the panel, and complete panel removal.

cases.predicate: the green expansion board is visibly outside the desktop chassis
cases.qualification_notes: A green expansion board is visibly removed around 77.5 s, well before the legacy 85 s positive. Avoid merging later board handling into the same occurrence.

cases.predicate: the round tabletop is visibly clear of the white support frame
cases.qualification_notes: Separate grasping, initial lift, complete clearance and setting the top aside.

cases.predicate: the long black rail is visibly separated from the remaining table frame
cases.qualification_notes: Fastener manipulation is preparatory; the target is clearance of one tracked long rail from the remaining frame.

cases.predicate: the paper drawer below the main front cover is visibly extended with its interior exposed
cases.qualification_notes: Specify the paper drawer below the main front cover. Do not merge it with later toner-cover opening.

cases.predicate: the detached reservoir is positioned under visibly flowing faucet water
cases.qualification_notes: Higher-resolution review distinguishes alignment/handle operation at 26–27 s from clearly visible flowing water at about 27.5 s, earlier than the legacy 33 s label.
